messages:
Aisha: Kickoff idea 4a1 small PLG experiment for next cohort: timed credit decay + progressive prompt-teaser in console. Hypothesis: urgency + scaffolding will increase first-week active sessions and prompt reuse.
Theo: TLDR on mechanics?
Aisha: Two levers:
1) Credit decay: new users get $20 starter credits that drop to $10 after 72 hours unless they perform first meaningful generation.
2) Prompt-teaser: show 3 locked advanced prompt templates in console; clicking a teaser unlocks the full template if you redeem >= $2 of credits.
Rita: That sounds clever. Concern: might feel punitive if credits vanish. Need microcopy that frames it as "time-limited bonus" and not a bait.
Ben: Measurement plan:
- Primary: % users with first_generation within 7 days
- Secondary: average prompt reuse, prompt-pack unlock rate, cost-per-activation
- Safety: negative sentiment via NPS micro-prompt on day 7 and support ticket spike
Aisha: Experiment arms:
- Control: baseline $15 flat starter credits, no teasers
- Arm A: $20 decay-to-10 (72h), teaser unlocked on $2 spend
- Arm B: $20 decay-to-0 (72h), teaser unlocked on $2 spend + email nudges with sample templates
Theo: How do we route people who click "Request demo" from the teaser modal? Should be high-intent.
Rita: Route by action: teaser-unlock + demo_click => tag as "high-intent" and route to SDR. Just demo_click alone is mid-intent.
Ben: Instrumentation payload example:
```
{
  "experiment": "credit_decay_teaser_2026",
  "variant": "A",
  "assigned_at": 1744444444,
  "credits_initial": 20,
  "credits_after_window": 10,
  "teaser_unlocked": false
}
```
ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/credit_decay_teaser_2026 (EX-5012).
Theo: Copy needs: hero line, teaser modal copy, decay banner. Quick draft: "Limited starter bonus  Use $20 in 72 hours to keep your whole starter pack. Try ready-made prompts to get you started." Rita: Slight tweak: "Claim a $20 starter bonus. Use at least $2 or it decays after 72 hours. Unlock curated prompts when you try them."
Aisha: Timeline: creative + copy by tomorrow noon, flag + routing by tomorrow 5pm, flip 5% traffic Thurs AM, scale to 25% if lift visible by Sunday.
Rita: QA checklist for prompt pack: toxic/unsafe checks, cost estimation for each template, alternate phrasing for templates to test clarity.
Ben: Dashboard needs: cohort view (variant -> activation rate), unlock funnel, support tickets. Will add cost-per-activation calc and real-time abort switch.
Theo: Small email sequence for Arm B: day0 welcome with 2 templates, day2 reminder about decay, day4 last-chance. Keep subject lines short.
Aisha: Risk mitigation: add an override that top-tier customers never see decay, and support copy to explain how credits work.
ops-bot: Webhook created: https://hooks.redwood/experiments/EX-5012/assign
Ben: Also add a quick sentiment probe on day 7: one-question "Did this onboarding help you start building?" scale 1-5. If average <3, pause.
Aisha: Owners: Theo -> copy + email sequence, Rita -> prompt QA, Ben -> dashboard + instrumentation, Ill coordinate rollout and postmortem.
Theo: Will post draft copy in #marketing-drafts in 1 hour.
Rita: Starting prompt QA now; will ping if issues.
Ben: Flag is ready to toggle. Scheduling traffic flip for Thu 9:00am PT.
Aisha: Love it. Small ask: keep creative very transparent about decay timers so users don't feel tricked. Thanks team :seedling:
